intro: The Fang of Githyiss is a rare and formidable specimen taken from a giant arachnid stalking the wilds near Aldrassil. Delivering the fang to a naturalist in the sanctuary allows scholars to study the monstrous creature and monitor the predatory threats nesting within Shadowglen.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My, my. How I do love surprises, friend.
This specimen will surely help further my studies.
